regions.finding: Two explicitly cited prior-work arrows, one current generic product-space question, and one unobserved branching Pd-intermediate mechanism were classified separately.

regions.region: middle-right Scheme 2 reaction and five-row condition table
regions.finding: Five distinct optimization experiments for 1a plus PhI were extracted row by row, including Ag2CO3 presence/absence, solvent, temperature, time, combined yield, dr, recovered starting material, and conditions A designation.

Prose links the first trials to Scheme 2, identifies the major 3e configuration as trans by NOESY, and states the p-bromoiodobenzene chemoselectivity later tabulated on page 2; cited background was not treated as current experiments.
NMR versus isolated-yield basis, recovered 1a percentages, and the conditions A definition were applied only to their corresponding rows.

regions.region: upper-left Table 1 generic arrow and entries 1-15

Crude-NMR dr method, separable-minor exceptions, cis-not-observed result, HPLC confirmations, and the 400 MHz override were attached only to the applicable rows.
Four successive arrows preparing (R)-1b were recorded independently with the displayed reagents and yields; omitted operating details remain missing.
Three current-paper chiral cyclizations to (R,R)-3k, -3l, and -3m were recorded separately from Table 1 because the displayed yields and ee data differ.
Prose confirms the Scheme 3 identities; the CHIRALPAK AD HPLC method was retained as the ee measurement method rather than a reaction condition.
The article states that experimental details and spectra for 3a-o exist in SI, but no SI file is supplied in this pilot, so no association was inferred.
